stem.text: A gas is contained in a cylinder by a movable piston.

stem.alt: Cylinder containing gas below a piston, with the piston shown at a final position and an initial position, dashed dimension lines marking 35.0 cm and 30.0 cm from the base, and a width of 20.0 cm across the base.

stem.text: The cylinder has a circular cross-section of diameter $20.0\,\text{cm}$.
The pressure of the gas is $102\,\text{Pa}$ and the piston is initially $30.0\,\text{cm}$ from the base of the cylinder.
The gas is heated causing the piston to move up so that it is $35.0\,\text{cm}$ from the base. The pressure of the gas remains constant.
How much work does the gas do in moving the piston?
